annotations.title: Get a MaxPreps team schedule and scores

description: Every game for a team season, with the result and both scores. Scores are oriented team-vs-opponent (`teamScore`/`opponentScore`); the raw `resultString` MaxPreps renders is winner-first, so a loss reads "L 20-13" even when the team scored 13. Soft-deleted contests are hidden by default, matching the site. Before opening day a current season legitimately has no results — check a prior season. Also returns any playoff or championship tournaments the season fed into. Read-only.

includeDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted contests the site hides

includeTournaments.description: Include playoff/championship tournament entries the schedule references

played.description: Filter to games with a result, games without one, or both

season.description: Season label, e.g. 25-26. Omit for the current season.

team.description: Team site path or URL, e.g. nc/charlotte/myers-park-mustangs/football

name: maxpreps_get_schedule
title: Get a MaxPreps team schedule and scores
